name: codex-content-project-workflow
description: Run video, animation, and content projects with OpenAI Codex like a small studio. Sets up a brief, a style guide, a list of every reference, and approval gates from storyboard to final render. A producer skill hands one shot at a time to builder, frame-checking reviewer, and researcher runs via codex exec; built-in skills cover content basics, motion, design, and character design.
